novelty_basis: Equivalent to the open periodicity problems for Officers (0.6), Treblecross (0.007, OEIS A395248) and 0.06 (Guy's conjecture that finite octal games are ultimately periodic). Our computation (n <= 3000) finds no period <= 300; the 0.06 Grundy sequence is not in the OEIS.
statement: The Grundy sequences of the rewriting games of aa -> ab, aaa -> b and aaa -> ab on the words a^n are ultimately periodic.
title: Open: are the rewriting games of aa -> ab (Officers), aaa -> b (0.007) and aaa -> ab (0.06) ultimately periodic?
